## Variables

### var ErrBareQuote

```go
var ErrBareQuote = errors.New("bare \" in non-quoted-field")
```

ErrBareQuote is returned when a bare quote appears in an unquoted field.

### var ErrFieldCount

```go
var ErrFieldCount = errors.New("wrong number of fields")
```

ErrFieldCount is returned when a record has an unexpected number of fields.

### var ErrQuote

```go
var ErrQuote = errors.New("extraneous or missing \" in quoted-field")
```

ErrQuote is returned for an invalid quoted field.

### var ErrTrailingComma

```go
var ErrTrailingComma = errors.New("extra delimiter at end of line")
```

ErrTrailingComma is retained for source compatibility. Deprecated: ErrTrailingComma is no longer used.

### type Reader

```go
type Reader struct { ... }
```

Reader reads records from CSV-encoded input.

#### field Reader.Comma

```go
Comma rune
```

Comma is the field delimiter. It defaults to a comma.

#### field Reader.Comment

```go
Comment rune
```

Comment, when nonzero, identifies lines to ignore.

#### field Reader.FieldsPerRecord

```go
FieldsPerRecord int
```

FieldsPerRecord controls the expected number of fields in each record.

#### field Reader.LazyQuotes

```go
LazyQuotes bool
```

LazyQuotes permits quotes in unquoted fields and malformed quoted fields.

#### field Reader.TrimLeadingSpace

```go
TrimLeadingSpace bool
```

TrimLeadingSpace ignores leading Unicode space in each field.

#### field Reader.ReuseRecord

```go
ReuseRecord bool
```

ReuseRecord permits Read to reuse the backing array of its previous result.

#### field Reader.TrailingComma

```go
TrailingComma bool
```

TrailingComma is retained for source compatibility and is not used. Deprecated: trailing commas are handled without this field.

#### func Reader.FieldPos

```go
func (r *Reader) FieldPos(field int) (int, int)
```

FieldPos returns the line and column corresponding to field in the most recently returned record.

#### func Reader.InputOffset

```go
func (r *Reader) InputOffset() int64
```

InputOffset returns the byte offset of the end of the most recently read record.

#### func Reader.ReadAll

func (r *Reader) ReadAll() ([][]string, error)
